methods.workforce: Exact profession/HSDA/year join between original count and rate cells; no rates recomputed
methods.wage: Six exact NOC codes × five exact BC reporting labels; original fallback scope, methods and missing values retained
methods.staffing: Original overtime fraction×100; denominator independently verified against worked overtime+regular hours
methods.vacancies: Original count/share cells; fraction × 100; fiscal periods derived from Table 8 quarterly method, retaining the 2020 exception
methods.sectorWage: Original BC sector/calendar-year/hourly-weekly rows pivoted without averaging

rights: CIHI public-source attribution and original publisher terms apply. No contact, personal-compensation, participant or interview records enter this release.
Job Bank metadata declares the Open Government Licence—Canada. Wage estimates retain original reference periods, comments and methodology.
Statistics Canada source attribution and original dissemination terms apply.
mappingLimits: HSDA 51/52/53 exact names reviewed against existing polygons.
Wage ER 5950/5960/5970/5980 use 2021 PGMaps context geometry; source geometry vintage is not independently pinned. BC aggregate 59 has no ER polygon.
BC staffing, vacancies and sector wages remain provincial charts/tables and are never allocated to HSDAs, LHAs or facilities.
